chapterBreakdown.gentle:
Once scales are in view, the book can shift from frame design to recurring variation. The chapter turns to patterns and asks when judgment differences show up again rather than appearing only once.

That matters because some differences in judgment do not look like isolated accidents. They recur in ways that begin to seem stable across cases.

This is where the chapter changes the reader's attention. Instead of asking only how one judgment went wrong, it asks whether a repeated tendency keeps returning in the same direction or style.

The chapter keeps one useful limit visible. A recurring pattern matters, but it does not become a total theory of the person or the whole process.

That is what earns the next move. Once recurring patterns are visible, the book can widen the frame again and turn to the sources of noise.
chapterBreakdown.direct:
The chapter focuses on patterns in judgment. It argues that some differences recur across cases instead of appearing as isolated accidents.

That matters because recurring variation can reveal stable tendencies in the way judgments are made. The repetition itself becomes part of the explanation.

This is the distinction it has to keep. Stable personal variation can matter for noise without turning into a fixed personality taxonomy or a complete explanation of every case.

The limit stays visible. The chapter is not saying that every repeated tendency is destiny. It is saying that recurring differences deserve attention.

That prepares the next step. After surfacing patterns, the book can move toward a broader account of the sources of noise.
chapterBreakdown.competitive:
The chapter stops looking for one-off slips and starts watching for tracks in the floor.

That matters because some wobble keeps returning in a recognizable way instead of appearing as random weather.

This is where the chapter tightens the lens. A repeated style of judging can matter across cases, but the book refuses to turn that pattern into a throne or a fixed badge for the person.

The discipline stays narrow on purpose. No personality chart appears, and no repeated move gets to explain the whole room.

That is what sets up the next step. Once the tracks are visible, the book can survey the broader sources of noise.
